pairs.target: dìsānshísān tiān xiàwǔ , tǎ wéi dúzì qù le jiù cè shì .
pairs.english: On the afternoon of day thirty-three, Tavi went alone to the old-ledger room.
pairs.hanzi: 第三十三天下午，塔维独自去了旧册室。

pairs.target: yīwén yào pái gē , línzǒu bǎ jièshū pái wǎng zhuōshàng yì pāi , shuō ruò yǒurén wèn , jiù shuō tā zhècì zhēnde qù chàng zuìhòu yíduàn .
pairs.english: Iven had choir practice. Before leaving, he slapped his borrowing token on the table, saying that if anyone asked, he really was going to sing the last verse this time.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文要排歌，临走把借书牌往桌上一拍，说若有人问，就说他这次真的去唱最后一段。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi ná nà kuài pái . tā yào kàn de cèzǐ bùnéng jiè zǒu , zìjǐ de jìlùběn yǐjīng gòuyòng le .
pairs.english: Tavi left the token. His reference books couldn't leave the room; his own notebook was enough.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没拿那块牌。他要看的册子不能借走，自己的记录本已经够用了。

pairs.target: guǎn guìzi de lǎorén huílái le , zhèng cǎi zài ǎi tī shàng , bǎ jǐjuàn zhǐ sāijìn zuìshàngcéng .
pairs.english: The old cupboard keeper was back, standing on a low ladder and stuffing scrolls onto the highest shelf.
pairs.hanzi: 管柜子的老人回来了，正踩在矮梯上，把几卷纸塞进最上层。

pairs.target: tā tīng tǎ wéi shuōwán , méi xiān wèn tánhuáng , fǎndǎo wèn tā néng bunéng fú yíxià tīzǐ .
pairs.english: After hearing Tavi out, he didn't ask about the spring first, but whether Tavi could hold the ladder.
pairs.hanzi: 他听塔维说完，没先问弹簧，反倒问他能不能扶一下梯子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fúzhù . lǎorén xiàlái shí , gēbo dǐxià jiá zhe yìběn huī fēngmiàn de mùlù , fēng jiǎo mó dé fābái .
pairs.english: Tavi steadied it. The old man descended with a gray-covered catalog under his arm, its worn corners nearly white.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维扶住。老人下来时，胳膊底下夹着一本灰封面的目录，封角磨得发白。

pairs.target: " sānnián qián de . nǐ yào zhǎo wù wān nà jiā ? " " shì . "
pairs.english: “Three years old. You want the Mistbay firm?” “Yes.”
pairs.hanzi:
“三年前的。你要找雾湾那家？”
“是。”

pairs.target: " hòu bànběn , xiūpèi nà yìlán . wǒ xiān shōu zhè duī , zhǎobùzhe zài jiào wǒ . "
pairs.english: “Second half, the repairs section. I'll put these away first. Call me if you can't find it.”
pairs.hanzi: “后半本，修配那一栏。我先收这堆，找不着再叫我。”

pairs.target: mùlù bǐ shàng huí de báo , zhǐ yě méi nàme cuì .
pairs.english: The catalog was thinner than the last, and its paper less brittle.
pairs.hanzi: 目录比上回的薄，纸也没那么脆。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàozhe yè biān de zì mànmàn fān , kànjiàn chéngtào de lúnzhóu , dài kǒng de liánjiē piàn , háiyǒu yì zhěngyè tā jiào bù chū míngzì de jiājù .
pairs.english: Tavi turned pages slowly using the marginal labels, finding complete axle assemblies, perforated connecting plates, and a whole page of clamps he couldn't name.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维照着页边的字慢慢翻，看见成套的轮轴、带孔的连接片，还有一整页他叫不出名字的夹具。

pairs.target: tāmen zài lú chǎng wǎngwǎng zhī shèng yígèjiǎo , yì jié gān , zài zhèlǐ què dōu yǒu wánzhěng de yàngzi .
pairs.english: At the furnace yard these often survived as a corner or a length of rod; here each had its whole shape.
pairs.hanzi: 它们在炉场往往只剩一个角、一截杆，在这里却都有完整的样子。

pairs.target: tā zài yìzhāng zhìdòng jià de tú qián tíng le hěn jiǔ . yuánlái zìjǐ cóngqián dàngzuò tíshǒu de nàgēn wān tiě , shì ràng liǎngbiān yìqǐ dòngzuò de hénggān .
pairs.english: He lingered over a brake-frame drawing. The curved iron he had mistaken for a handle was actually a crossbar that moved both sides together.
pairs.hanzi: 他在一张制动架的图前停了很久。原来自己从前当作提手的那根弯铁，是让两边一起动作的横杆。

pairs.target: pángbiān huà le shǒuzhǎng , gàosù yòng de rén gāi wǎng nǎlǐ tuī .
pairs.english: A hand drawn beside it showed the user where to push.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边画了手掌，告诉用的人该往哪里推。

pairs.target: fān dào wù wān jī zuò suǒ shí , liǎngdào yuèyá réng zài . zì xiàmiàn duō le yìháng xiūpèi dìzhǐ : lù chà , xià héxī zhī .
pairs.english: At Mistbay Works, the two crescents remained. Below the name was an added repair address: Deerfork, western branch of the Lower River.
pairs.hanzi: 翻到雾湾机作所时，两道月牙仍在。字下面多了一行修配地址：鹿汊，下河西支。

pairs.target: tā bǎ " lù " rènchéng le yígè bǐhuà tài duō de wūdǐng , chāo le yíbàn , zìjǐ juéde bú duì , cái jǔshǒu jiào lǎorén .
pairs.english: He mistook the character for “deer” for an overcomplicated roof, copied half of it, then realized something was wrong and raised his hand for the old man.
pairs.hanzi: 他把“鹿”认成了一个笔画太多的屋顶，抄了一半，自己觉得不对，才举手叫老人。

pairs.target: lǎorén niàn gěi tā tīng , shùnbiàn cóng jiàshàng chōuchū yíjuàn xínglù tú .
pairs.english: The old man read it to him and pulled a route map from the shelf.
pairs.hanzi: 老人念给他听，顺便从架上抽出一卷行路图。

pairs.target: tā ná liǎngkuài mùtou yāzhù juàn biān , zài héliú fēnchà de dìfāng diǎn le yíxià .
pairs.english: He weighted the curling edges with two wooden blocks and pointed to a fork in the river.
pairs.hanzi: 他拿两块木头压住卷边，在河流分岔的地方点了一下。

pairs.target: " zhèlǐ . búshì nǐmen qù liáng péngzǐ de jiùzhàn , hái yuǎn dé hěn . "
pairs.english: “Here. Not the old station you measured. Much farther.”
pairs.hanzi: “这里。不是你们去量棚子的旧站，还远得很。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yánzhe tā de shǒuzhǐ kàn . tú shàng de shān jǐ zài shàng bànjié , hédào cóng shānjiǎo shēnchū qù , dào le xià fāngbiàn fēnchéng xǔduō xìxiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi followed his finger. Mountains crowded the upper half; rivers stretched from their feet, splitting into many fine lines below.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维沿着他的手指看。图上的山挤在上半截，河道从山脚伸出去，到了下方便分成许多细线。

pairs.target: lù chà de zì hěnxiǎo , pángbiān què huà le mǎtóu , wūzi hé liǎngtiáo dù xiàn .
pairs.english: Deerfork's label was tiny, yet beside it stood a wharf, houses and two ferry lines.
pairs.hanzi: 鹿汊的字很小，旁边却画了码头、屋子和两条渡线。

pairs.target: " shì zài shān wài ? " " zhè zhāng tú de hùlù jiè dào zhèér . "
pairs.english: “Outside the mountains?” “This map's maintained-road boundary ends here.”
pairs.hanzi:
“是在山外？”
“这张图的护路界到这儿。”

pairs.target: lǎorén wǎng shàngyí le yíduàn , " xiàmiàn yǒu tāmen zìjǐ de lù . nǎtiáo xiànzài hǎo zǒu , dé wèn zǒuguò de rén . "
pairs.english: The old man moved his finger upward. “Below that they have roads of their own. Ask someone who's traveled them which are passable now.”
pairs.hanzi: 老人往上移了一段，“下面有他们自己的路。哪条现在好走，得问走过的人。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán biàn huíqù zhěnglǐ zhǐjuàn , liú tǎ wéi zìjǐ kàn . méiyǒu shuí hūrán yādī shēngyīn , yě méiyǒu shuí bǎ nà yì jiétú gàiqǐlái .
pairs.english: He returned to sorting scrolls, leaving Tavi to look. Nobody suddenly lowered their voice or covered that part of the map.
pairs.hanzi: 他说完便回去整理纸卷，留塔维自己看。没有谁忽然压低声音，也没有谁把那一截图盖起来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ mùlù yí dào dìtú páng . dìzhǐ xiàmiàn yǒu yìfú xiǎo mùkè , huà zhe línshuǐ de gōngchǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi moved the catalog beside the map. A small woodcut beneath the address showed a waterfront workshop.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把目录移到地图旁。地址下面有一幅小木刻，画着临水的工场。

pairs.target: wūzi jià zài gāo zhuāng shàng , yìgēn chánggān shēn guòshuǐmiàn , gāntóu diào zhe bàngè lúnzǐ .
pairs.english: The building stood on high stilts. A long beam projected over the water, half a wheel suspended from its end.
pairs.hanzi: 屋子架在高桩上，一根长杆伸过水面，杆头吊着半个轮子。

pairs.target: hòumiàn de chuāngwài liàngzhe jǐjiàn yīfu , qízhōng yìtiáo kùzǐ duǎn dé xiàng háizi chuān de .
pairs.english: Clothes hung outside the rear window; one pair of trousers was short enough to belong to a child.
pairs.hanzi: 后面的窗外晾着几件衣服，其中一条裤子短得像孩子穿的。

pairs.target: tā yuánxiān xiān kàn lúnzǐ , zhèhuìer què rěnbúzhù kàn nàtiáo kùzǐ .
pairs.english: He had looked at the wheel first; now he couldn't help looking at those trousers.
pairs.hanzi: 他原先先看轮子，这会儿却忍不住看那条裤子。

pairs.target: wù wān jī zuò suǒ búshì zhī zài jiù cèzǐ lǐ liú le yígè yìn .
pairs.english: Mistbay Works was more than a stamp left in an old ledger.
pairs.hanzi: 雾湾机作所不是只在旧册子里留了一个印。

pairs.target: zhìshǎo zhèběn mùlù yìnchūlái de shíhòu , yǒurén yuànyì ràng yuǎnchù de rén zhīdào , huàidōngxī kěyǐ sòngdào nǎlǐ , xìn gāi xiěgěi nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: At least when this catalog was printed, someone wanted distant people to know where to send broken things and address their letters.
pairs.hanzi: 至少这本目录印出来的时候，有人愿意让远处的人知道，坏东西可以送到哪里，信该写给哪里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bù zhīdào nàfú huàhuà de shì shuíjiā , yě bù zhīdào nàxiē yīfu shìbushì kè tú de rén suíshǒu tiān de , kě tā xiǎng kànkàn zhēnde chuāngzǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't know whose home the picture showed, or whether the engraver had simply added the clothes, but he wanted to see the real windows.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维不知道那幅画画的是谁家，也不知道那些衣服是不是刻图的人随手添的，可他想看看真的窗子。

pairs.target: zhí zhuō de nǚrén duān zhe shuǐ jìnlái , jiàn dìtú tānzhe , tì tā bǎ kuài gǔnxiàqù de mùkuài wǎng lǐ tuī le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: The desk attendant came in with water. Seeing the open map, she nudged a block away from the table's edge for him.
pairs.hanzi: 值桌的女人端着水进来，见地图摊着，替他把快滚下去的木块往里推了一点。

pairs.target: " zhǎodào méiyǒu ? " " zhǎodào le dìzhǐ . " " nà jiù bǎ niánfèn yě chāo shàng . "
pairs.english: “Found it?” “An address.” “Copy the year too, then.”
pairs.hanzi:
“找到没有？”
“找到了地址。”
“那就把年份也抄上。”

pairs.target: tā zhào zuò le . sānnián qián , lí jīntiān bìng bùyuǎn , kě yě búshì jīntiān .
pairs.english: He did. Three years ago wasn't so far from today, but it wasn't today either.
pairs.hanzi: 他照做了。三年前，离今天并不远，可也不是今天。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu zài pángbiān xiě " réng zài kāigōng ", zhī xiě le zhèběn cèzǐ jì de shì shénme .
pairs.english: He didn't write “still operating” beside it, only what the catalog recorded.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有在旁边写“仍在开工”，只写了这本册子记的是什么。

pairs.target: kàn wán tú , tā chóngxīn náchū zìjǐ de tánhuáng cǎotú .
pairs.english: After the map, he took out his spring sketch again.
pairs.hanzi: 看完图，他重新拿出自己的弹簧草图。

pairs.target: mùlù lǐ yǒu jǐzhǒng xiāngjìn de dànpiàn , chángdù , kǒngyǎn dōu bù yíyàng , dānpíng nàge yìn réng fēnbùchū shì nǎ zhǒng .
pairs.english: The catalog had several similar spring strips, with differing lengths and holes; the stamp alone still couldn't identify the type.
pairs.hanzi: 目录里有几种相近的弹片，长度、孔眼都不一样，单凭那个印仍分不出是哪种。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zuì xiàng de liǎngzhāng tú yè hào jìxià , méiyǒu yìng tiāo yìzhāng .
pairs.english: He noted page numbers for the two closest drawings without forcing a choice.
pairs.hanzi: 他把最像的两张图页号记下，没有硬挑一张。

pairs.target: lǎorén shōuwán zhǐjuàn guòlái , wèn tā zhǎodào de dōngxī yǒuméiyǒu yìsī .
pairs.english: The old man finished sorting the scrolls and asked if what he'd found was interesting.
pairs.hanzi: 老人收完纸卷过来，问他找到的东西有没有意思。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō yǒu , yòu wèn , xiàcì xiǎng wèn tāmen zhè piàn dōngxī yuánlái zhuāng zài nǎlǐ , xìn néng bunéng zhēnde sòngdào .
pairs.english: Tavi said yes, then asked if a letter asking where the piece had originally fitted could really reach them.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说有，又问，下次想问他们这片东西原来装在哪里，信能不能真的送到。

pairs.target: " yǒurén zǒu nàtiáo shānglù , néng tuō zhuǎn . " lǎorén shuō ,
pairs.english: “People travel that trade road. You can ask them to forward it,” the old man said.
pairs.hanzi: “有人走那条商路，能托转。”老人说，

pairs.target: " nǐ xiān bǎ wèntí xiě qīng . wèn língjiàn , jiù huà língjiàn . zhī jì yígè yìn , rénjiā yě bù zhīdào nǐ quē nǎyíkuài . "
pairs.english: “Write the question clearly first. If it's about a part, draw the part. Send only a stamp, and they won't know which piece you're missing.”
pairs.hanzi: “你先把问题写清。问零件，就画零件。只寄一个印，人家也不知道你缺哪一块。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu kàn zìjǐ huà de quēkǒu , hūrán juéde háiyǒu hěnduō dìfāng yào liáng .
pairs.english: Tavi looked down at the notch he had drawn, suddenly aware how much remained to measure.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头看自己画的缺口，忽然觉得还有很多地方要量。

pairs.target: tā bǎ biānshàng de wènhào liú zhe , lìng qǐ yìháng , xiě le zìjǐ néng quèdìng de hòudù hé kuāndù .
pairs.english: He kept the question mark and began a new line with the thickness and width he could establish.
pairs.hanzi: 他把边上的问号留着，另起一行，写了自己能确定的厚度和宽度。

pairs.target: líkāi yǐqián , tā bǎ dìtú chóngxīn juàn hǎo . dìyīcì juàn dé wāi , hédào xié zhe pǎo dào zhǐbiān , tā chāikāi chóng lái .
pairs.english: Before leaving, he rolled the map again. His first attempt was crooked, the river slanting toward the paper's edge, so he unrolled it and started over.
pairs.hanzi: 离开以前，他把地图重新卷好。第一次卷得歪，河道斜着跑到纸边，他拆开重来。

pairs.target: lǎorén méi cuī , zhèngzài dītóu bǔ fēngpí shàng de xiàn .
pairs.english: The old man didn't hurry him; he was mending the cover's stitching.
pairs.hanzi: 老人没催，正在低头补封皮上的线。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn huídào yuànlǐ , yīwén cóng pái gē de wūzi chūlái , wèn tā shìbushì zài jiù cè shì shuìzháo le .
pairs.english: Back in the courtyard at dusk, Iven emerged from the rehearsal room and asked whether Tavi had fallen asleep among the ledgers.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚回到院里，伊文从排歌的屋子出来，问他是不是在旧册室睡着了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ jì zhe dìzhǐ de nà yè gěi tā kàn . " wǒ xiǎng yǐhòu qù kànkàn . "
pairs.english: Tavi showed him the page with the address. “I want to visit someday.”
pairs.hanzi:
塔维把记着地址的那页给他看。
“我想以后去看看。”

pairs.target: " lù chà ? " yīwén dú le liǎngbiàn , " wǒ méi qùguò . "
pairs.english: “Deerfork?” Iven read it twice. “I've never been.”
pairs.hanzi: “鹿汊？”伊文读了两遍，“我没去过。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běnlái yǐwéi tā huì shuō yuǎn , huòzhěshuō lù bùhǎo zǒu . tīngjiàn zhè jù , fǎnér xiào le .
pairs.english: Tavi had expected him to say it was far or the roads difficult. Instead, this answer made him smile.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本来以为他会说远，或者说路不好走。听见这句，反而笑了。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ zhǐ háigěi tā , wèn nàbiān mài bu mài yú . " tú shàng méi xiě . " " nà háiyǒu dé chá . "
pairs.english: Iven returned the paper to him and asked if they sold fish there. “The map doesn't say.” “More to find out, then.”
pairs.hanzi:
伊文把纸还给他，问那边卖不卖鱼。
“图上没写。”
“那还有得查。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ běnzi hé shàng . tā zuótiān jiāogěi běi gōng fāng de nà fēngxìn yǐjīng wǎng fēn lùkǒu qù le , lǐmiàn hái méiyǒu zhège dìzhǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi closed his notebook. The letter he'd handed to the north workshop yesterday was already heading for the junction, without this address in it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把本子合上。他昨天交给北工坊的那封信已经往分路口去了，里面还没有这个地址。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng , xià yìfēng kěyǐ duō huà yíshàn chuāng .
pairs.english: Perhaps he could draw another window in the next letter, he thought.
pairs.hanzi: 他想，下一封可以多画一扇窗。
